assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness accompanied by a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks and known sick sinus syndrome.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or conduction abnormalities that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring.
The claim was denied under Reason Code CO-197.
The denial indicates that the required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
